stem: The author of the excerpt from “What the Octopus Knows” and the poet of the poem “Narwhals Are Real” would most likely agree with which of these statements?

options.text: An unexpected opportunity to learn can lead to strong interest.
Successful researchers must avoid strong emotions about their subjects.
Investigation is the first step to bonding between humans and animals.
Researching a topic can be surprisingly time-consuming.
Many people share similar admiration for certain sea creatures.
